items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well I think that was the last engagement that we played, excuse me, that we played for him was when she was out there.

ctx.x: I can't think of his name. He's a little Jewish fella. I can't think of his name right now. But anyhow we made a couple of engagements for him. We played at the Tin Angel in San Francisco. Oh yeah. We played that about three times, nine months in all. Then we played for, for Doc Dorothy at the Hangover. Yeah. Played for him a couple of times.
That was when Lizzie Miles and Joe Robertson came out there. That's right, yeah.
Well I think that was the last engagement that we played, excuse me, that we played for him was when she was out there.
